Subject: Hosted API commit uptick & tier questions

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from Acme as we prepare our Q4 roadmap: we expect a 2.5x increase in token volume for product search and summarization between Oct–Dec. Were evaluating a higher monthly commit (moving from our current hosted 500k token band to a 1.5M band) and we have two immediate questions:

- How would rate limits change at the 1.5M commit? We need sub-150ms p95 latency for short-response search queries.
- Can we keep the same burst pocket for holiday traffic (wed like a 30% burst over the committed band) and how does billing for burst overage get invoiced?

Procurement asked that we get a rough cost delta and an updated SOW/PO template so they can start the review. Im looping procurement (procurement@acme-retail.com) on this thread.

Can you propose the simplest path to ramp? If theres an ops handoff required for the Dedicated/private plans, flag that too.

Thanks,
Amira Kahn
Head of Platform, Acme Retail
amira.kahn@acme-retail.com

Amira — thanks for the heads up and the PO draft. Short answers up front, followed by a proposed path: 

- Rate limits: at the 1.5M monthly commit we can raise the baseline per-route concurrency and token-per-minute windows. For short search responses well target p95 < 150ms on our hosted tier with the following config: continuous batching disabled for low-latency routes + dedicated fast-path kernels. The SLO is achievable but requires pinning the model variant (we recommend rwd-open-llama-13B-q4f) and enabling the latency lane.

- Burst: we can grant a 30% burst pocket for the holiday window as a time-limited addendum. Billing for burst above the pocket is per-token at the agreed overage rate; we can set a soft-alert at 80% consumption and hard cap at 140% without auto-throttle (your choice).

Proposed path (simple, low lift):
1) Option A (recommended): Move to Hosted 1.5M commit, 30% time-limited burst pocket (Nov 15–Dec 31), keep current model pinned + latency lane. Price delta: +$18k/month (summary in attached matrix).
2) Option B (faster): Temporary monthly top-up during Q4 (no commit change) + burst pocket. Slightly higher unit rates.

Next steps Id suggest: Lauren will own the SOW/terms and Vanessa will coordinate operations + onboarding checklist. If procurement needs a PO-ready SOW we can produce one with the commit table and burst clause. Ill also generate a commit_change_matrix for the financials.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

2) For billing, procurement prefers a single monthly invoice that includes any overage line items rather than separate consumption invoices. Can you confirm you can provide an itemized monthly invoice?

If those are OK Ill kick off internal approvals today. Procurement asked that we get a PO + SOW in the next 72 hours.

Amira
